statement: Exact Fourier transforms below $`n\log n`$. Gives a deterministic length-n discrete Fourier transform algorithm using $`O(n(\log n)^{1-\delta})`$ operations for every n, with explicit $`\delta=10^{-13}`$. The model uses exact complex arithmetic, unrestricted coefficients and a supplied root of unity, and counts scalar preparation and logarithmic-word indexing.
